content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant barriers when it comes to setting up an online store. Conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-one-afternoon-fast-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors like Stripe and PayPal are often inaccessible, leading to lost opportunities. COREMERCH offers two architectural stacks designed to empower creators with sovereign commerce solutions: Stack 01, leveraging GitHub Pages and Apps Script, and Stack 02, utilizing Cloudflare Pages and Workers. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-plain-language-infrastructure-19|understanding]] the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-solutions-when-stripe-paypal-20|The Real]]s between these options is crucial for maximizing your digital storefront's potential.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01 is a straightforward solution, using GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend functionality. This stack can be deployed in 4-6 hours if you follow the Sovereign Blueprint. It’s ideal for creators looking for a quick setup with minimal complexity but is limited in scalability and features. In contrast, Stack 02 offers a more robust architecture. Built on Cloudflare Pages and Workers, combined with Supabase for database management, Stack 02 is designed for creators who need more reliability and scalability. This stack is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, ensuring that every aspect is end-to-end tested before handoff, providing a stronger infrastructure for serious digital commerce.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Stack 01 and Stack 02 cater to creators in regions where payment processors are restricted. Stack 01’s use of GitHub Pages is a practical option for immediate deployment, allowing users to bypass traditional hosting limitations. However, its reliance on Apps Script may limit functionality under high traffic. Stack 02, on the other hand, leverages Cloudflare's global CDN, making it better suited for heavy loads and diverse geographical regions. This means Stack 02 can handle a larger audience without compromising performance, making it a preferable choice for creators concerned about international reach and payment processing.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, both stacks utilize NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification, thus ensuring low fees of just 0.5%. Stack 01’s setup is simple but may encounter delays due to the reliance on Google Apps Script for order logic. Stack 02, with its Cloudflare Workers architecture, provides faster payment confirmations and a more efficient backend process. This means not only quicker transactions but also a smoother customer experience, which can lead to higher conversion rates. For those focused on cost-effectiveness and speed, Stack 02 offers clear advantages.
Stack 02 is built for scalability, making it ideal for growing digital businesses.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a crucial consideration for digital creators. Both stacks provide full data ownership post-deployment, but Stack 02 offers a significant edge in terms of automation and delivery capabilities. Stack 01 gives you basic automation through Apps Script but lacks the sophisticated features that come with Supabase in Stack 02. This means that with Stack 02, you can easily manage orders, track sales, and deliver products automatically, ensuring a more seamless experience for you and your customers. The enhanced automation in Stack 02 means less manual work and more time for you to focus on creating.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Your choice between Stack 01 and Stack 02 should depend on your immediate needs and long-term growth plans. If you're a creator looking to quickly launch a simple store without extensive features, Stack 01 is a suitable option. However, if you anticipate scaling your business, handling a larger audience, or requiring more advanced features, Stack 02 is clearly the better choice. It’s built for resilience and efficiency, which will pay dividends as your digital store grows. Ultimately, aligning your choice with your business goals will ensure you have the right infrastructure in place.

Your Deployment Checklist

First, choose the stack that suits your needs: Stack 01 for quick deployment or Stack 02 for enhanced features. Next, set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure the backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Test your store on mainnet to ensure everything works flawlessly. Finally, promote your store to reach your audience effectively.
